title: 30A Fade Away
meta_description: Welcome to 30A Fade Away by AvantStay!
description_expanded:
Welcome to 30A Fade Away by AvantStay!

Where coastal serenity meets timeless 30A charm, this inviting Santa Rosa Beach retreat is tucked among the trees just moments from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf. Set on a quiet lane surrounded by greenery, the home offers peaceful privacy while keeping you close to the area's best---bike to Eastern Lake, stroll to local cafés, or spend sun-soaked days exploring Seaside, Rosemary Beach, and other nearby coastal gems.

From the moment you arrive, the wraparound porch welcomes you with Southern warmth. Rocking chairs and a porch swing invite slow mornings with coffee in hand and evening conversations under the stars. Inside, a bright open layout seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining, and living areas---perfect for groups who love to gather. Soft neutral tones, natural textures, and plenty of sunlight create a space that feels both cozy and elevated.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for effortless meals, while the dining table for six sets the stage for shared dinners after a day in the sun. The adjacent living room offers plush seating and a large TV, ideal for movie nights or simply unwinding in comfort.

Three bedrooms comfortably sleep up to eight guests. The primary suite features a king bed and ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. A queen room and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks provide flexible sleeping arrangements for families or groups of friends. A second full bathroom with a shower/tub combo and a convenient washer and dryer add extra ease to your stay.

Step outside to the peaceful yard, where tall trees and coastal breezes set the scene for barbecues and relaxed afternoons. You'll also have access to a nearby communal pool---perfect for cooling off after a beach day.

Whether you're here to unwind or explore, 30A Fade Away offers the best of both worlds: a tranquil hideaway surrounded by nature, just minutes from the sand, surf, and charm of Florida's Emerald Coast.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A Pack'n'Play is available for guest use.

Parking Details:
- This home offers parking for two vehicles, one in the driveway and one parallel spot in front of the house.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
